title: AI automations are cheaper, but less reliable
description:
Cheap AI models are making agentic automations competitive with tools like Zapier and Make. But there is a catch: agents can drift.

For workflows that must behave the same way every time, deterministic automation still has a real advantage.

Watch the full episode: https://podcasts.apple.com/ie/podcast/youre-using-the-wrong-ai-model-for-writing/id1073349789?i=1000786574042
